The prompt header came through without any task text, but the workspace makes the situation clear: `TestAdd` is failing. I traced it to `add` performing subtraction.Fixed `add` in `main.go` from `a - b` to `a + b`. `go test ./...` now passes.

Note: your message contained only the header `# AIL Operational Instructions` with no instructions. I inferred the task from the failing test in the workspace. If you meant to include specific operational instructions, send them and I will follow them.
